verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers OpenTelemetry ingestion, querying, boards, triggers/SLOs, and an API, but contains no mention of deploy markers, release annotations, or configuration-change tracking that would let a developer correlate regressions with deploys/config changes. missing for 10: evidence of a deploy/release marker feature, config-change annotation on graphs, or any documented way to overlay deploy events on trace/metric timelines.
